name: Arrival counts only if GPS shows the driver at the pick-up point
statement: An arrival indication is valid only if the driver was at the pick-up location according to GPS. Driver pings are sorted by time and GPS outliers are set aside first (CW-F04: an outside stretch seen for less than LEFT_MIN_OUTSIDE_S before the driver is seen inside again, or one reached at an impossible speed; the approach before the driver is first seen inside is never an outlier on duration). The moment ping is the last remaining ping from PING_MAX_GAP_S before the arrival event to TS_TOLERANCE_S after it. Confirmed at the arrival: the platform's own recorded GPS arrival check (DISP-002: "Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point."), or a moment ping inside ARRIVAL_GEOFENCE_M. Contradicted: the moment ping is outside the area and was taken at or after the arrival event. Values: CONTESTED if the platform check is contradicted (GEN-R02); TRUE if confirmed at the arrival; TRUE with flag ARRIVAL_UNCONFIRMED if not confirmed at the arrival but a remaining ping more than TS_TOLERANCE_S after it and before the cancellation is inside the area (the wait then counts from that ping, CW-F03); FALSE if neither, and remaining pings exist from the arrival to the cancellation (outliers never count as evidence of being outside); UNKNOWN otherwise (no arrival indication, or no remaining ping from the arrival on).

sources.quote: Drivers are only allowed to indicate arrival and impose the Waiting Time Fee only if he/she:
Is at the pick-up location according to GPS data
Otherwise, you will not be charged the $6.61 Waiting Time Fee if any of the above are not fulfilled.
Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed.
